alpha_composite_premul — GFX2D composite op

• Data kinds: rgba_premul × rgba_premul → rgba_premul

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.alpha_composite_premul(src, dst) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import gfx2d; gfx2d.alpha_composite_premul(src, dst), registry से लेना हो तो opsgfx2d.get("alpha_composite_premul"))

उपयोग

premultiplied रंग पर Porter–Duff over: src + dst*(1 - src.a)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

This is the operator; alpha_composite is this one with a conversion on each side. Being affine in dst, it is exactly associative — over(over(A, B), C) == over(A, over(B, C)) to float64 rounding, which the test suite checks as an equality rather than a tolerance.
